name: [UPD 2] Anime Duelists
desc:
📌 Spin stars to unlock fighters, send fighters into battle, and collect rewards in anime-inspired worlds!

Use the code: RELEASE

⚔️ Game Features:
- 🌟 Spin Stars: Earn random fighters and build your team of powerful fighters to dominate your enemies!  
- 🐾 Unique Fighters & Abilities: Each fighter has its own ultimate attack, adding depth and strategy to every battle.  
- 🏆 Quests & Rewards: Complete quests to unlock exclusive mounts and gather rare rewards!  
- 🌍 Explore Diverse Worlds: Journey through anime-inspired realms, each with unique enemies, challenges, and rewards.
